learning_objective: 🎯 Let us become nature explorers and discover the wonderful world of plants, trees, and leaves around us!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Plants come in all sizes! Big, strong plants with thick wooden trunks are called trees, like the Mango tree. Smaller bushy plants are called shrubs, like the Rose plant.
Some plants have very weak stems. Climbers need a stick or wall to grow upwards, like a money plant. Creepers just grow spreading along the ground, like a big pumpkin plant!
Leaves are the kitchen of the plant because they make food using sunlight! They come in so many different shapes, sizes, and colors. Some even smell amazing, like mint and coriander.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Leaf Art Magic!
fun_activity.instructions: Go on a nature walk in a park and collect 3 different types of fallen leaves. Bring them home, place them under a paper, and rub a crayon over them to make beautiful leaf prints!

quick_recap: ⭐ Trees are big and strong, while shrubs are small and bushy.
⭐ Climbers go up with support, and creepers spread on the ground.
⭐ Leaves use sunlight to make food for the whole plant.
